releaseNotes:
﻿## Meals
- Print the meal plan as a compact A4 portrait fridge sheet (dishes, cooks, headcounts, allergies, notes), scaled to fit one page
- Meal plan week settings remain under Meals → Settings (independent of the weekly schedule)

## Conferences & bookings
- Room conflicts no longer wipe the form — your details stay filled in
- When a room is already reserved, you can **Save with shared room** so both bookings keep that room
- Conference arrival/departure follow conference start/end until you change them manually

## Fixes
- Conference and booking save errors stay on the same page instead of redirecting away
